name: internships
//deps: drizzle-orm and postgres are deliberately NOT listed here. This package imports the web app's table definitions from ../src/db/schema.ts, and drizzle's types are nominal — two installed copies make the root's PgTable objects unassignable to this package's query builder, which fails to typecheck. Leaving them out lets Node/Bun resolution walk up to the single copy in the repo root's node_modules. Install the root package first.
